intent: Phase 2: build the output canary, so a future file move can be proved output-neutral rather than asserted. Warrant WG-ARCH-006 (B, behaviour pinned first). All 2,279 tests are option A: no snapshot, golden or characterisation test and no output hash exists, which is why the 2026-07 module move was made without one and why WG-ARCH-001 cannot rule C. Source row WO-0008. Every later phase leans on this task. Acceptance: (1) a build-output hash or golden set that a pure file move leaves unchanged; (2) it runs in a gate; (3) npm run seed-pack's deterministic artefacts are covered; (4) added by plan amendment 2026-08-22, beyond the row's original text, a deliberate one-line change is proved non-neutral by the same gate, so the canary cannot pass trivially. Done when a future move can be proved output-neutral rather than asserted. Tier proposal R2, anticipated factor ci-stateful-infra from derived signal ci-config, evidence the canary must run in a gate, which means a job under .github/workflows/. Closed 2026-08-22 in 966d8dc4 and 86b3cf0f. Independent review rejected the first version twice and was right both times: a segmentConfig regex that could never match inside a goldened surface, a missing docs/OUTPUT_CANARY.md that three failure messages pointed at, and then a golden that hashed raw bytes so it could never survive crossing from a Windows checkout to a Linux runner. All fixed, with tests pinning the properties rather than the incidents. Proved in both directions and green on CI across Linux and macOS.
